assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is coded with CPT 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I25.10 corresponds to atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The diagnosis code I34.0 corresponds to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The associated symptom code R42 further supports that these unexplained dizziness episodes warrant continuous ambulatory cardiac monitoring to detect intermittent dysrhythmias
